Name: Passport ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the passport. Only available when updating existing records.

Name: Legislation Code
Description: The passport legislation code.

Name: Passport Number
Description: The passport number.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person whose passport this is.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person whose passport this is.

Name: Expiration Date
Description: The expiration date of the passport.

Name: Issue Date
Description: The issue date of the passport.

Name: Issuing Authority
Description: The issuing authority for the passport.

Name: Issuing Country
Description: The name or code of the country of the public agency that has provided the person's passport.

Name: Issuing Location
Description: The issuing location for the passport.

Name: Passport Type
Description: The type or category of the passport.

Name: Profession
Description: The profession of the passport holder.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application.
